author: potatoarmor
body:
It was just the two of us, I was three blocks from the lava and was typing a message to him (asking for arrows), he blocks a few blocks out to make lava flow to me.  It was a pretty quick action, I didn't have time to react and burned.

Picture 1 shows that I was spleefed into lava by him (the text).

http://i.imgur.com/EiEkoKX.jpg

Picture 2 shows where I was standing.

http://i.imgur.com/1pfo1Ve.jpg

If this is not enough to at least temp ban him, keep your eyes on him.  He is one of those players that wants diamonds at any cost, including team killing.  Another reason why diamonds should not be in Walls but that's another thread.

Update: I was talking about him on Walls with Murph_the_cat, Trakr64 has a reputation for team killing so I wasn't the first one (and probably won't be the last).
